feature_order.final_40: current dictionary indicators[16], prefix row occupancy[16], dominant-event fractions[4], log dwell[4]
feature_order.prior_fit: sequence-level moments and exact-level counts from that cell's source-qualified fitting rows only; deterministic tie-break; never evaluation groups
feature_order.transform_numeric_detail: statistics and categorical counts are accumulated in FP64; the final 60 feature channels are cast to FP32; raw model inputs remain FP32

precision.feature_preprocessing: FP64 accumulators for causal geometry statistics, then cast feature tensor to FP32

training.resume: atomic epoch-boundary training_state.pt; incomplete cell resumes with the same source/config/profile receipt and preserves phase attempts
training.update_budget_note: counts are inherited from the frozen R4 recipe and must be checked against the actual eight-card profile and every terminal history; discrepancy is an execution stop-and-diagnose condition, not a silently revised result

data.exposure: all four folds are exposed or potentially exposed development panels; no fresh holdout claim
data.payload_handling: supplied data, target caches and chain caches are mounted on the B300 host and excluded from Git and the evidence archive

contrasts.familywise_adjustment: Holm correction over these four preregistered two-sided tests
contrasts.estimand: equal-weight mean of the four fold means; within each fold average paired per-seed WP differences over its available seeds

fitting_seed_bootstrap.method: resample the eight shared seed identities with replacement; use the same seed multiplicities in all folds; renormalize among available seeds within each fold; redraw if a fold has zero sampled seed weight
fitting_seed_bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%, approximate and conditional on these exposed folds, fitting membership, and ancestry

evaluation_component_bootstrap.method: hold trained cells fixed; resample source-qualified evaluation components independently within each fold; apply identical component multiplicities to every arm and seed; recompute official WP and the equal-fold contrast
evaluation_component_bootstrap.interval: reported separately from seed variation; does not cover new fitting seeds, folds, or regimes

contrasts.null_rule: center the paired-seed bootstrap contrast distribution at zero for an approximate two-sided p-value; apply Holm to the four p-values; report all unadjusted and adjusted values with the seed-bootstrap intervals
contrasts.limitations: only eight seed identities, seven in F2/F3; bootstrap and p-values are approximate; no zero-crossing interval is an automatic family rejection

outcome.useful_effect_note: +0.001 absolute WP is a direction for useful follow-up, not a kill threshold.
outcome.success: a useful positive primary contrast with compatible per-fold behavior and independent component uncertainty; preserve secondary/interaction evidence even if primary is inconclusive
outcome.failure: negative or noisy concatenation narrows this exact fresh H512 recipe; it does not reject warm continuation, teacher targets, feature-only student support, distillation, or fixed mixtures

profile_gate.required_evidence: one source SHA; eight unique B300 identities; overlapping profile windows; finite updates; strict FP32 flags; measured time/update, CPU RSS, CUDA allocated/reserved peaks, and training update budget
profile_gate.wall_time_policy: record measured card profiles and complete update totals; do not estimate or advertise B300 wall time before observing the actual hardware
profile_gate.launch_requirement: inspect the sealed profile receipt and actual wall-clock/update throughput against available allocation before starting the 120 scientific cells

current_evidence.r1: causal moment pilot mean delta +0.0008833 on a tiny exposed panel with opposing fold effects; all conditional component intervals crossed zero
current_evidence.r2: H32x1 and H128x2 four-arm screens on 43 fitting/46 exposed evaluation sequences show capacity- and combination-dependent effects; fixed half-mixtures suggest possible conditional value
current_evidence.r3: fresh H128x2, 8-epoch screen, 3 paired seeds, 43 fitting/46 exposed evaluation sequences: moments -0.019742, dictionary +0.000501, combined -0.017251 WP versus control on average; fixed control+dictionary mixture +0.007337
current_evidence.interpretation: tiny panels and few seeds; not statistically significant, no production/teacher/KD/public claim. The strongest alternative is extra input capacity/optimization interaction and seed/slice noise rather than a stable feature-regime effect.
current_evidence.mechanism_limit: bounded/discrete support mixtures can yield mean/variance arc relations; ~46% arc inliers are descriptive, not proof of a universal circle, periodicity, market regime or physical semantics.

root_local_warm_probe.scope: one exposed F0/seed3 warm fit pair; fixed endpoints over 468 sequences and 141 components; component bootstrap only, no seed/fold/public-transfer uncertainty
root_local_warm_probe.interpretation: Both children drifted below the parent; the small feature-control difference is not independent confirmation and does not reject the feature family.
